integrity: The theorem has an explicit finite-dimensional proof and independently replayable finite checks. All numerical checks are illustrative; no independent priority or correctness certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic profile assumes a fixed finite cycle, unit nearest-neighbor hopping, and a localized initial site. The exceptional exact-flattening times characterize a limiting finite-window average, not exact finite-duration uniformity. No open-system noise, higher-dimensional lattice, nonuniform flux, or varying cycle size is claimed. Equivalent earlier treatments of singular near-degenerate spectral averages cannot be excluded without broader expert review.
title: Magnetic-flux boundary layer and exceptional exact flattening of averaged quantum cycles
